text: ari: Heads-up — deep links from the SDK quickstart to /guides/sdk#rate-limits sometimes land at top-of-page or the warning box instead of the section. Found during a smoke test. noah: That usually means duplicate ids or weird chars in slugs. Can you paste the link + the page heading? ari: Link: https://docs.redwood.ai/guides/sdk#rate-limits. On the page the heading is `### Rate limits — rate-limiting best practices`. Also there's an inline image earlier with `` (legacy HTML). noah: Bingo — explicit `id` on the image + generated slug for the heading = duplicate anchor. Browser jumps to the first match (the img). Linkcheck didn't catch it previously. Quick fixes: remove `id` from the image or add `{#rate-limits}` to the heading and update CI to fail on duplicate ids. maya: I'll open a tiny PR to remove the stray `id` on the img, add an explicit heading id as a belt-and-suspenders measure, and add a grep step in the linkcheck job to detect duplicate ids. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3599 ci-bot: Running linkcheck for PR #3599. Build commands: `yarn docs:linkcheck` and `mkdocs build --strict`. Additional check: `grep -oP 'id="[^"]+"' .site/**/*.html | sed 's/id="//;s/"//' | sort | uniq -d`. docs-bot: Reviewers requested: @noah, @ari. ci-bot: Linkcheck found duplicate id `rate-limits` in guides/sdk.html (2 occurrences). Failing job to surface problem. noah: LGTM, thanks — merged commit `c4a9d2b`. Removed stray img id and added `### Rate limits {#rate-limits}`. Kept the duplicate-id grep in CI. ari: Verified quickstart deep link now jumps to the section correctly. Filing follow-up task to scan the repo for inline HTML ids and prefer explicit heading ids in markdown. maya: Added note to CONTRIBUTING.md: "Avoid raw HTML ids in docs; prefer explicit heading ids or native markdown elements". If anyone sees odd fragments, drop them here or open a small PR. :thumbsup:
